extraction: runtime. Every instrument was recorded while the library created it against the SDK MeterProvider returned by its own auto_instrument._setup_meter_provider(), read back through an InMemoryMetricReader. `bucket_boundaries` are what that reader reported after one probe value. `attribute_keys_observed` are the data point attribute keys seen while driving BaseInstrumentor and EvaluationSpanProcessor (null = that code path was not driven). `attribute_keys_static` is an ast scan of the .add()/.record()/Observation() call sites and is the only source for instruments that were not driven. NVML was simulated with one fake device so the per-GPU gauges register; see `requires_gpu_device`.
